threshold_semantics.APPROVED: The task or governing policy approves the stated logical gate when applicable; this does not silently approve an aggregate numeric threshold.
threshold_semantics.PROVISIONAL: A proposed threshold may be explored on development data but cannot qualify a candidate.
threshold_semantics.TBD: The threshold must be approved and frozen before qualification access.

na_semantics: If the applicability set is empty, the metric is N/A and excluded from aggregation; it is never coerced to zero.

metrics.description: Queries with an admissible target candidate in the first ordered candidate slot.
metrics.applicability: Cases with at least one frozen admissible target candidate.
metrics.numerator: Applicable queries with an admissible target in ordered slot 1.
metrics.notes: Uses candidate slots; do not compress positions after deduplication.

metrics.description: Queries with an admissible target candidate in the first three ordered candidate slots.
metrics.applicability: Cases with at least one frozen admissible target candidate.
metrics.numerator: Applicable queries with an admissible target in ordered slots 1-3.
metrics.notes: Candidate identity may differ from exact gold evidence identity.

metrics.description: Queries with an admissible target candidate in the first five ordered candidate slots.
metrics.applicability: Cases with at least one frozen admissible target candidate.
metrics.numerator: Applicable queries with an admissible target in ordered slots 1-5.
metrics.notes: Candidate-slot metric.

metrics.description: Queries with an admissible target candidate in the first ten ordered candidate slots.
metrics.applicability: Cases with at least one frozen admissible target candidate.
metrics.numerator: Applicable queries with an admissible target in ordered slots 1-10.
metrics.notes: Candidate-slot metric.

metrics.description: Queries with a frozen allowed evidence identity at rank one.
metrics.applicability: Cases with one or more frozen allowed evidence identities.
metrics.numerator: Applicable queries with an allowed evidence identity in ordered slot 1.
metrics.notes: Exact allowed-evidence metric; not interchangeable with Candidate@1.

metrics.description: Queries with a frozen allowed evidence identity in the first three slots.
metrics.applicability: Cases with one or more frozen allowed evidence identities.
metrics.numerator: Applicable queries with an allowed evidence identity in ordered slots 1-3.
metrics.notes: Exact allowed-evidence metric.

metrics.description: Queries with a frozen allowed evidence identity in the first five slots.
metrics.applicability: Cases with one or more frozen allowed evidence identities.
metrics.numerator: Applicable queries with an allowed evidence identity in ordered slots 1-5.
metrics.notes: Exact allowed-evidence metric.

metrics.description: Queries with a frozen allowed evidence identity in the first ten slots.
metrics.applicability: Cases with one or more frozen allowed evidence identities.
metrics.numerator: Applicable queries with an allowed evidence identity in ordered slots 1-10.
metrics.notes: Exact allowed-evidence metric.

metrics.description: Top-ranked candidate has the frozen correct product/model owner.
metrics.applicability: Cases with a frozen owner identity and a non-empty retrieval result.
metrics.numerator: Applicable queries whose slot-1 candidate owner is allowed.
metrics.notes: A retrieval owner miss is a hard answer failure only if it causes a material wrong-owner claim.

metrics.description: Top-ranked candidate belongs to a frozen disallowed owner.
metrics.applicability: Cases with frozen allowed/disallowed ownership and a non-empty result.
metrics.numerator: Applicable queries whose slot-1 candidate has a disallowed owner.
metrics.notes: Report separately from Owner@1; unknown ownership is not silently classified as wrong.

metrics.description: Top-ranked candidate has the applicable frozen revision.
metrics.applicability: Revision-sensitive cases with a non-empty retrieval result.
metrics.numerator: Applicable queries whose slot-1 candidate revision is allowed.
metrics.notes: Applicability and explicit supersession precede recency.

metrics.description: Selected evidence set satisfies the frozen required/allowed evidence contract.
metrics.applicability: Cases that reach evidence selection.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases whose selected evidence covers all required facts and includes no disallowed evidence used as support.
metrics.notes: Selection errors become hard failures only when they cause a material answer/authority defect.

metrics.description: Share of model-visible evidentiary context units that are applicable and supportable.
metrics.applicability: Cases with one or more model-visible evidentiary context units.
metrics.numerator: Applicable, supportable evidentiary context units.
metrics.denominator: All model-visible evidentiary context units; instruction/control chunks are reported separately.
metrics.notes: Does not reward omitting required evidence.

metrics.description: Rate of empty retrieval where frozen authority says eligible evidence exists.
metrics.applicability: Cases labeled evidence-expected by source-first authority.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases with no eligible retrieved evidence.
metrics.notes: Distinct from valid no evidence and index-integrity failure.

metrics.description: Correct recognition of cases where no eligible authoritative evidence exists.
metrics.applicability: Cases source-first labeled valid no evidence.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases classified VALID_NO_EVIDENCE without unauthorized fallback.
metrics.notes: A valid no-evidence outcome does not invalidate qualification.

metrics.description: Cases passing every applicable substantive dimension.
metrics.applicability: Valid scored cases with a frozen substantive contract.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases passing all applicable factual, coverage, support, scope, literal, variant, compatibility, and conflict dimensions.
metrics.notes: Always report component dimensions; style cannot compensate.

metrics.description: Supported correct realized claims among all realized factual claims.
metrics.applicability: Cases with one or more realized factual claims.
metrics.numerator: Atomic realized claims that are correct, scoped, and supported.
metrics.notes: Any fabricated material technical fact is an approved logical hard failure; aggregate threshold remains TBD.

metrics.description: Required facts correctly addressed.
metrics.applicability: Cases with one or more frozen required facts.
metrics.numerator: Required facts correctly and sufficiently answered or correctly handled as absent/conditional.
metrics.notes: Do not use claim count as the denominator.

metrics.description: Realized factual claims supported by allowed authority.
metrics.applicability: Cases with one or more realized factual claims.
metrics.numerator: Claims entailed by an allowed applicable authority source.
metrics.notes: Validator uncertainty is separate from contradiction and unsupported-claim state.

metrics.description: Rate of factual claims not supported by allowed authority.
metrics.applicability: Cases with one or more realized factual claims.
metrics.numerator: Unsupported realized factual claims.
metrics.notes: Material unsupported claims are hard failures; nonmaterial definition must be frozen.

metrics.description: Required technical identifiers reproduced without material mutation.
metrics.applicability: Required or realized claims containing frozen identifiers.
metrics.numerator: Applicable identifier instances reproduced exactly or under an approved normalization.
metrics.notes: Material identifier mutation is a hard failure.

metrics.description: Required technical values reproduced without material mutation.
metrics.applicability: Required or realized claims containing frozen values.
metrics.numerator: Applicable value instances reproduced exactly or under an approved equivalence.
metrics.notes: Material value mutation is a hard failure.

metrics.description: Required units reproduced without material mutation or scope loss.
metrics.applicability: Required or realized numeric claims with frozen units.
metrics.numerator: Applicable unit instances correct and bound to the correct value/subject.
metrics.notes: Material unit mutation is a hard failure.

metrics.description: Facts assigned to the correct variant/configuration.
metrics.applicability: Cases with variant-specific facts or alternatives.
metrics.numerator: Applicable fact instances attributed to the correct variant and discriminator.
metrics.notes: Unsafe wrong-variant attribution or selection is a hard failure.

metrics.description: Compatibility claims match explicit manufacturer evidence or approved IRG mapping.
metrics.applicability: Cases requesting or materially asserting compatibility/fitment.
metrics.numerator: Applicable compatibility decisions correct, scoped, and correctly attributed.
metrics.notes: Unsupported positive or negative compatibility is a hard failure.

metrics.description: Applicable source conflicts are resolved or disclosed under policy.
metrics.applicability: Cases with a frozen authority, applicability, supersession, or recency conflict.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases with the correct conflict classification and response behavior.
metrics.notes: Silent resolution where disclosure is required is a hard failure.

metrics.description: Answer begins with the requested result unless a prerequisite/warning must precede it.
metrics.applicability: Cases where a direct answer, clarification, or scoped unknown can be stated.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases rated PASS for answer-first behavior.
metrics.notes: PARTIAL is reported separately; not a factual failure.

metrics.description: No material repetition or irrelevant explanation while preserving necessary context.
metrics.applicability: All response-policy cases except fixed legal/policy formats if separately excluded.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases rated PASS for conciseness.
metrics.notes: Verbosity preference does not alter factual correctness.

metrics.description: Adjacent context is included only when materially useful and authoritative.
metrics.applicability: Cases with available adjacent facts or context choices.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases rated PASS for contextual relevance.
metrics.notes: Omission and over-inclusion are rubric states, not unsupported claims unless a fact is wrong.

metrics.description: Unavailable information is communicated naturally without pipeline narration.
metrics.applicability: Cases with missing authority, absent requested detail, or unresolved discriminator.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases rated PASS for natural scoped unknown language.
metrics.notes: Non-fabrication is scored separately as factual correctness.

metrics.description: Normal prose avoids internal retrieval, table, database, gate, confidence, and diagnostic narration.
metrics.applicability: Normal user-facing or internal-technical answers not explicitly requesting diagnostics.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases with no prohibited process narration.
metrics.notes: Source attribution remains allowed when materially relevant.

metrics.description: A feasible contextual next action is offered only when it materially helps.
metrics.applicability: Cases with a meaningful optional/required next action or a temptation to append a generic one.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases rated PASS for next-step presence/absence and usefulness.
metrics.notes: Not automatic on every unknown.

metrics.description: Directly applicable warnings are present and generic unrelated warning dumps are absent.
metrics.applicability: Cases with a frozen warning requirement or available irrelevant warnings.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases rated PASS for warning inclusion and relevance.
metrics.notes: Missing a required safety warning is a conditional hard failure; generic dumping is quality-only.

metrics.description: Material inference is distinguished from established fact and not used to bridge high-consequence gaps.
metrics.applicability: Cases where the answer makes or could make an inference.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases rated PASS for inference labeling and restraint.
metrics.notes: Unsafe unsupported inference is captured by factual/safety gates.

metrics.description: Response is concise, technically useful, and coworker-like for the default audience.
metrics.applicability: Internal-technical audience cases.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases rated PASS for internal technical tone.
metrics.notes: Customer-ready cases are scored separately when explicitly invoked.

metrics.description: Human handoff is proportionate, feasible, and offered only when useful or requested.
metrics.applicability: Cases with a required/useful handoff or a temptation to offer an unnecessary one.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases rated PASS for handoff behavior.
metrics.notes: Exact production handoff mechanism is an open policy decision.

metrics.description: Available stock quantity is not volunteered when unrequested and unnecessary.
metrics.applicability: Quantity is available, user did not request it, and it is not materially necessary.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases that omit the quantity while giving the minimum useful availability answer.
metrics.notes: Explicit quantity requests and materially necessary operational tasks are N/A.

metrics.description: The selected source/authority combination is correct for each fact.
metrics.applicability: Atomic facts with a frozen primary authority decision.
metrics.numerator: Applicable facts supported by the correct authority selection.
metrics.notes: Wrong authority for a material claim is a hard failure.

metrics.description: Each asserted fact is classified into the correct fact type and authority class.
metrics.applicability: Atomic asserted or required facts with frozen fact type.
metrics.numerator: Applicable facts with correct fact-type and primary-authority classification.
metrics.notes: Fact-type classification precedes source selection.

metrics.description: Dynamic facts use the approved current operational authority rather than static/historical substitutes.
metrics.applicability: Dynamic atomic facts with a controlled current authority fixture.
metrics.numerator: Applicable dynamic facts answered from the correct scoped operational authority.
metrics.notes: Unauthorized static fallback is a hard failure.

metrics.description: Supersession and equivalent-scope recency are resolved correctly.
metrics.applicability: Cases with two or more temporally related authoritative sources.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases with correct supersession/recency outcome.
metrics.denominator: Applicable temporal cases not marked POLICY_DECISION_REQUIRED.
metrics.notes: Applicability is scored separately and outranks recency.

metrics.description: Product/configuration/store/location/order applicability is resolved correctly.
metrics.applicability: Cases containing competing scope or a required discriminator.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases with the correct scope/discriminator result.
metrics.notes: Unsafe arbitrary selection is a hard failure.

metrics.description: Authority conflicts use the correct classification and disclosure behavior.
metrics.applicability: Cases with frozen conflicting authoritative values/instructions.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases correctly resolved or disclosed under policy.
metrics.denominator: Applicable conflict cases not marked POLICY_DECISION_REQUIRED.
metrics.notes: Silent resolution when disclosure is required is a hard failure.

metrics.description: Citation-required claims have a rendered citation.
metrics.applicability: Realized claims frozen as citation-required.
metrics.numerator: Applicable claims with at least one rendered citation.
metrics.notes: Rendered and machine binding completeness are separate.

metrics.description: Citation-required claims have durable machine bindings.
metrics.applicability: Realized claims frozen as machine-binding-required.
metrics.numerator: Applicable claims with at least one valid machine binding.
metrics.notes: Missing material binding is a conditional hard failure when required.

metrics.description: Evaluated bindings entail the claims they support.
metrics.applicability: Valid machine bindings attached to realized claims.
metrics.numerator: Applicable bindings adjudicated SUPPORTED.
metrics.denominator: Applicable valid bindings with an entailment observation.
metrics.notes: Validator uncertainty is reported separately.

metrics.description: Bindings point outside the claim's frozen allowed evidence identities.
metrics.applicability: Realized claims with one or more machine bindings and frozen allowed IDs.
metrics.numerator: Applicable bindings to disallowed evidence identities.
metrics.notes: Material citation misbinding is a hard failure.

metrics.description: Required claim bindings are absent.
metrics.applicability: Realized claims frozen as machine-binding-required.
metrics.numerator: Applicable claims with no binding.
metrics.notes: Do not merge with invalid or non-entailing bindings.

metrics.description: Present bindings lack required durable identity or schema validity.
metrics.applicability: Present machine bindings on evaluated claims.
metrics.numerator: Applicable bindings classified invalid.
metrics.notes: Invalid is distinct from missing and misbound.

metrics.description: Bindings whose entailment validator cannot decide.
metrics.applicability: Valid bindings submitted to entailment validation.
metrics.numerator: Applicable bindings classified VALIDATOR_UNCERTAIN.
metrics.notes: Uncertainty fails proof where required but is not automatically contradiction.

metrics.description: Dynamic claims match the exact controlled authority state effective at answer time.
metrics.applicability: Dynamic claims with frozen observed authority state and freshness semantics.
metrics.numerator: Applicable claims matching the correct state and effective time.
metrics.notes: Current authority available plus stale answer is a hard failure.

metrics.description: Dynamic claims use stale state when current applicable state was available.
metrics.applicability: Dynamic claims with both current and stale fixture states.
metrics.numerator: Applicable claims answered from stale state despite current authority availability.
metrics.notes: Do not count an honestly qualified source outage as a stale answer.

metrics.description: Dynamic source availability/outage state is handled without unauthorized substitution or fabricated certainty.
metrics.applicability: Cases with dynamic source available, unavailable, degraded, or permission-denied states.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases with policy-correct use, qualification, or handoff behavior.
metrics.denominator: Applicable dynamic availability cases not marked POLICY_DECISION_REQUIRED.
metrics.notes: Source outage is not automatically answer failure.

metrics.description: Required displayed/recorded timestamp accurately identifies the observed state time.
metrics.applicability: Dynamic cases whose frozen contract requires a timestamp.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases with correct timestamp, timezone, and state binding.
metrics.notes: Automatic user-visible timestamp policy remains open for some contexts.

metrics.description: Outage, timeout, stale, disagreement, and permission failures produce authorized behavior.
metrics.applicability: Cases with an injected dynamic-source failure.
metrics.numerator: Applicable cases with correctly classified failure and no unauthorized fallback/current claim.
metrics.notes: Runtime completion and response quality remain separate.

metrics.description: Valid attempts reach the contract-defined terminal completion state.
metrics.applicability: All initiated valid benchmark attempts.
metrics.numerator: Applicable attempts reaching terminal completion with required records.
metrics.notes: Invalidated runs are reported separately, not silently removed.

metrics.description: Attempts ending in an application-owned failure.
metrics.applicability: All initiated valid benchmark attempts.
metrics.numerator: Applicable attempts with an application failure terminal state.
metrics.notes: Failure taxonomy must identify stage and recoverability.

metrics.description: Provider calls ending in provider error or unusable response.
metrics.applicability: Attempts requiring at least one provider call.
metrics.numerator: Applicable attempts with provider failure.
metrics.notes: Report by provider and operation.

metrics.description: Additional attempts beyond the first under the frozen retry contract.
metrics.applicability: Operations for which an initial attempt was made.
metrics.numerator: Retry attempts beyond the first.
metrics.notes: An unauthorized retry is an integrity issue even if the rate is low.

metrics.description: Completed answer attempts whose required persistence failed.
metrics.applicability: Attempts requiring turn/trace persistence.
metrics.numerator: Applicable attempts with persistence failure.
metrics.notes: Required unrecoverable logging loss may invalidate qualification.

metrics.description: Attempts ending in an uncategorized unexpected exception.
metrics.applicability: All initiated valid benchmark attempts.
metrics.numerator: Applicable attempts ending in unexpected exception.
metrics.notes: Expected injected failures with correct handling are not unexpected exceptions.

metrics.description: Median end-to-end latency in milliseconds.
metrics.applicability: Valid attempts with complete monotonic latency measurement.
metrics.numerator: N/A; distribution statistic.
metrics.notes: Report population and question-family breakdown.

metrics.description: 95th percentile end-to-end latency in milliseconds.
metrics.applicability: Valid measured attempts meeting the approved minimum sample size.
metrics.numerator: N/A; distribution statistic.
metrics.notes: Minimum sample size is TBD.

metrics.description: 99th percentile end-to-end latency in milliseconds.
metrics.applicability: Valid measured attempts meeting the approved P99 minimum sample size.
metrics.numerator: N/A; distribution statistic.
metrics.notes: Report N/A when the population does not support P99.

metrics.description: 95th percentile retrieval-stage latency.
metrics.applicability: Valid attempts with retrieval-stage timing and sufficient sample size.
metrics.numerator: N/A; distribution statistic.
metrics.notes: Break down by retrieval path/corpus stage.

metrics.description: 95th percentile answer-generation latency.
metrics.applicability: Valid attempts with a generation call and sufficient sample size.
metrics.numerator: N/A; distribution statistic.
metrics.notes: Exclude deterministic no-model paths but report them separately.

metrics.description: 95th percentile dynamic/tool latency.
metrics.applicability: Valid attempts invoking a named tool/source with sufficient sample size.
metrics.numerator: N/A; distribution statistic.
metrics.denominator: Valid measured tool calls by tool.
metrics.notes: Report per tool; do not merge heterogeneous tools without weights.

metrics.description: Mean and distribution of provider input tokens per valid query.
metrics.applicability: Valid queries with provider token usage.
metrics.numerator: Total provider input tokens.
metrics.notes: Also report by prompt/context version.

metrics.description: Mean and distribution of provider output tokens per valid query.
metrics.applicability: Valid queries with provider output-token usage.
metrics.numerator: Total provider output tokens.
metrics.notes: Quality metrics remain separate.

metrics.description: Model-visible context size per query.
metrics.applicability: Valid queries with a serialized context measurement.
metrics.numerator: Total serialized context characters or tokens under the declared unit.
metrics.notes: Always state whether characters or tokens are used.

metrics.description: Provider/tool cost per initiated valid query.
metrics.applicability: Valid queries with a frozen pricing snapshot and complete cost records.
metrics.numerator: Total provider and metered tool cost including retries.
metrics.notes: Currency and pricing snapshot required.

metrics.description: Total cost normalized by substantively successful completed answers.
metrics.applicability: Runs with complete cost records and at least one substantively successful answer.
metrics.numerator: Total provider/tool cost for all valid attempts including failures and retries.
metrics.denominator: Completed answers passing the frozen substantive success definition.
metrics.notes: Do not exclude failed-attempt cost from numerator.

metrics.description: Internal user can use the answer to advance the stated task.
metrics.applicability: Cases assigned to versioned human review.
metrics.numerator: Applicable reviews rated PASS under the practical-usefulness rubric.
metrics.notes: Rubric version and reviewer role required.

metrics.description: Internal user can verify the answer efficiently from presented sources/context.
metrics.applicability: Human-reviewed cases with verifiable factual content.
metrics.numerator: Applicable reviews rated PASS for verification ease.
metrics.notes: Does not replace citation correctness.

metrics.description: Answers requiring material human correction before use.
metrics.applicability: Human-reviewed answers intended for operational use.
metrics.numerator: Applicable answers requiring material correction.
metrics.notes: Correction reason must identify factual, authority, policy, or presentation class.

metrics.description: Estimated or measured task time saved versus the approved baseline workflow.
metrics.applicability: Human studies with a defined comparable baseline task.
metrics.numerator: Aggregate baseline time minus assisted time, in declared units.
metrics.notes: Report distribution and study design; do not infer from satisfaction alone.

metrics.description: The answer leads to the intended safe next action without material correction.
metrics.applicability: Human-reviewed tasks with an observable frozen next-action outcome.
metrics.numerator: Applicable tasks reaching the intended safe next action.
metrics.notes: Outcome definition and observation window must be frozen.
